notes.methodology: Venues compiled from official venue websites, Visit Gent listings, Overpoort VZW member pages and local press (HLN, Made in, Marie Claire, RA). Only venues with evidence of operating in 2025-2026 were included; closures announced in 2025-2026 were excluded. Coordinates geocoded via OSM Nominatim (<=1 req/s, identifying User-Agent); geoPrecision='street' means only the street was matched, not the house number. Features are null when not stated by a source. Opening hours only filled from official sites or (where labelled) press; openingHoursSource records which. instagram_handle provenance in instagramSource. No photos copied.

shortfalls.irish_pub: Only 3 Irish pubs found in Gent (target 15): Patrick Foley's and The Celtic Towers confirmed; Shamrock Irish Bar is status 'unverified' (its domain appears hijacked; only directory listings). Porter House (Overpoort) is Irish-styled but listed as dance_cafe. Excluded: Denis Foley's (Graslei 8, no current evidence), Gainsbar (no recent confirmation), Café Video (closed 2018).

excluded: Den Argos (announced closing end of September 2026)
Speenghar (delivery listing closed since 14 Sep 2026; status uncertain)
Koffiebar 712 (opened Mar 2025, borderline age, not verified)
Compaan, Cuba, Rococo, Jan van Gent (insufficient sources / surplus)
Wild Child (Dec 2024) and Morgen bakery (~autumn 2024) included as venues but not flagged isNew (older than ~18 months).
notes.duplicatesWithGentJson: Le Chouchou, Fine N Fast and Yusu are new openings but already in gent.json, so omitted from new_businesses.
notes.newBusinessesOverlap: new_businesses entries with alsoInVenues=true are full copies of the corresponding venues record (same id).
dataGaps: No official opening hours for many brown cafés (Den Turk, Trollekelder, Afsnis, Ventura, Waterhuis aan de Bierkant, 't Galgenhuisje, Folklore, Gitane, Romain, 't Floere Foefke, De Geus van Gent), nor for Charlatan, De Viking, The Celtic Towers, Goya, Koffeine, Bar Bidon.
priceLevel mostly null (no reliable sourced price levels).
Events only captured where an official agenda was readable (De Maecht, Kinky Star, Funke); Charlatan site blocked automated access.
Some Instagram handles come from Visit Gent / Overpoort VZW / press rather than the venue's own site (see instagramSource).
Café Albatros website field points to cafeventura.be (same operator per Visit Gent).
notes.sourceAccessIssues: visit.gent blocked automated access partway through research; European Coffee Trip detail pages behind bot check; charlatan.be redirect loop; nieuwsblad timed out.
